rounds.text: R G F Capital Markets Ltd is currently undergoing a massive operational transformation, evidenced by a dramatic acceleration in sales growth that has reached 315% over the trailing twelve months [E17]. This recent performance is not an isolated spike but part of a clear upward trend, with compounded sales growth accelerating from 61% over five years to 50% over three years [E15, E16]. This momentum significantly outpaces the sector median sales growth of 14.1%, signaling that the company is capturing market share at an aggressive rate [E63]. The business is currently demonstrating superior relative efficiency, maintaining a positive ROA of 0.32% and ROE of 0.3% while the sector benchmarks remain deeply negative at -104.68% and -11.79% respectively [E8, E9]. Conceded: [E1, E4, E14, E22, E23, E24, E25, E50, E56]. The market is beginning to recognize this shift, as evidenced by the stock trading at the top of its 52-week range [E5].
